_comment: The code review panel. /review-pr runs every lens in parallel; the report shows each. Add a lens here to add it to the panel. Checklist bundles per lens and tier live in lenses.json.

lenses.name: cassandra-standards
lenses.focus: patch vs its JIRA ticket, Cassandra contribution standards, security (self-gating), edits to .claude/ or AGENTS.md

lenses.name: cass-logic-boundary
lenses.focus: conditions, boundaries and numbers, null and type safety, input validation

lenses.name: cass-concurrency-lifecycle
lenses.focus: races, locking, lifecycle and ordering, resource cleanup

lenses.name: cass-persistence-compat
lenses.focus: serialization and versioning, mixed-version clusters, IO and crash safety, logging and metrics

lenses.name: cass-completeness-symmetry
lenses.focus: missing counterpart changes, API contracts, refactor aftermath

lenses.name: cass-test-regime
lenses.focus: right test suite, regression test fails without the fix, repeated runs
